RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is weak evidence on its own. Panels often reflect who holds senior roles, and leading with it may make you look aggrieved rather than wronged. More years of experience doesn't guarantee selection for a head-of-group role, where client relationships, business development and management often outweigh design depth.

What matters more is the stated criteria and how candidates were scored. Follow up firmly in writing on your request for an explanation. You may also be entitled to your interview notes and scores, for example through a data subject access request in the UK or EU. If the explanation is vague, inconsistent with the advertised criteria, or reveals sex-related remarks, then the panel's composition becomes relevant context. At that point, consult an employment adviser before raising it formally.
